checks: Complete range-arrow taps between frames are delivered once and subsequent taps still work
Several discrete taps between the same two frames retain their count and order
Held navigation emits one initial edge, ignores OS repeat, and retains bounded repeat timing
Held confirm never doubles; release and press between sampled frames generates a fresh action
Text editing, prevented events and native menu Tab do not become game actions
Game context buffers discrete camera, shift and Escape actions without latching continuous driving inputs
Clear, blur, visibility loss, disable and context changes discard queued actions
Consumed key metadata lasts one sample and is cleared with clear or context transition
Starting binding capture discards pending input; captured keys do not activate their old or new action
Calibration accepts only fresh confirm/back and cannot leak pending taps after cancellation
Legacy custom key bindings also produce short discrete action taps
limit: Actual InputManager with event-level keyboard ordering and deterministic Gamepad host; no physical hardware claim.
